name: Base Game House
author: olciaxxx_05
style: Raised periwinkle lap-siding house over a dark-brick garage storey: a front-gabled wing under a shingled pent skirt on white pilasters, the pale glazed front door in the recess up a long brick stair with white balusters, stepped board-and-batten cross gables, a dormer and a red-brick chimney, Italian cypress, arborvitae and birch
